II. חרץ be yellow (probably √ of following: Syriac id. (rare), yellow ; compare Aramaic חריע safflower , Arabic id.: see Nö ZMG 1886, 728 , Löw Aramaic Pflanzenn. 218 Kö ii. l. 137 ).
